title: What an epic final day of the first ever @The Festival! What a blast,...
transcript: day three of the festival and it's the last day y'all this is the longest standing ovation of the entire festival damn you Patti Murin it’s too early to cry just now discovering there's an entire second food truck area the downside is I am looking for a water bottle fill up Station and there isn't one over here deciding if I should grab food while I'm over here and Stewart’s Shops is giving out free ice cream so obviously the answer is more ice cream just did another half and half with the duet show which was a blast Some of my favourite performances of the weekend at that and then came to the end of the Tom Kitt concert I have an idea for a video however it is it is pouring rain right now I don't know if you can see that grabbed my last meal just filmed the most embarrassing video of my life Jackpot something god we're gonna have to do this one more time But I really wanted to do it so there you go before all the big shows Broadway Direct hosted trivia to give away theater tickets i did win Lost Boys tickets yesterday which was awesome this is a finish the lyric challenge and we're requesting that you sing it the ice cream truck was still open as we're walking out so obviously one last Sundae for the road great festival see y'all next year
classificationReason: Festival vlog covering multiple performances and events over several days; no single Broadway/West End production from the list is being reviewed. Lost Boys is only mentioned incidentally as a ticket giveaway prize.
